newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential cuts AT&T rating.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential cuts AT&T rating.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Michael Elling said he cut his rating on AT&T Corp to hold from buy.
-- said he reduced his earnings estimates to $3.51 per share from $3.75 for 1996, and to $3.60 from $4.25 for 1997.
-- reduced his 12-month price target for the new, core AT&T to $45 from $55,
-- said AT&T management has not performed well and company has not taken advantage of its strengths, and has been hurt in both revenues and earnings.
-- said that if the company were broken up today, the core AT&T would be selling at $37.
